client_id.description: The API client Nemura calls with: its scopes are Appendix E's and no other.

epoch.description: The link's epoch: every event carries it and an earlier one is refused (FR-PPL-16).

fyniq_client_public_key.description: The public half of the key Fyniq's own client signs its token request to Nemura's OAuth server with, as a JWK: Nemura registers it for Fyniq's client. Never the private key.

fyniq_link_key.description: Fyniq's Ed25519 public key for what Fyniq sends (payroll.run.posted, payroll.payments.status), 32 bytes as base64url without padding: Nemura checks every event against it. Give it to Nemura when it approves the link.

nemura_client_id.description: The ID Fyniq's client has at Nemura's OAuth server, as Nemura chose it when it proposed the link.

nemura_organisation_id.description: The Nemura organisation it is linked to.

oauth_client_id.description: The ID the link's client has at Fyniq's OAuth server: what Nemura signs its token request as. Give it to Nemura when it approves the link.

state.description: none: never linked; unlinked is final, and a later link starts at a higher epoch.
